_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

ftue-connect-source.text: Connect Google, or explore sample data first, as this build does. Your calendar lives on your machine, not someone else's.

tags-taxonomy.text: The same intention tags file two ways: under a direction, or under a time block category.

open.text: Your whole plan is one SQLite file you can copy and keep.

ftue-time-place.text: Wake and bed times. The planner folds the hours outside them away.

ftue-trust-dial.text: Then the trust dial — how much it may do unasked.

today-cockpit.text: Today is the cockpit. Twenty-four things staged, and it tells you they don't fit.

focus-now.text: Focus mode keeps the next task and its time box in view.

calendar-week.text: The calendar carries that day out to a week and a month.

calendar-month.text: Zoom out to the month: this week placed, and the rest of it still open.

tasks-backlog.text: Everything unplaced lives here, ranked by priority.

priorities-hours.text: Name the hours each part of your life deserves, before the week claims them.

balance-index.text: Balance scores how closely satisfaction tracks stated importance.

settings-schedule-patterns.text: Placement obeys the windows you set for work, home and community.

close.text: Plan on your terms with Companion Planning, at ci dot computer slash download. UnCloud your life.

one-line-in.text: Type one line. Companion Planning proposes the time and tag before anything is saved.

plan-the-week.text: Plan the week around the hours and priorities you actually have.

the-long-game.text: Above the day sit goals, projects and objectives, so a Tuesday has something to be for.

what-stays-yours.text: Your plan lives in one SQLite file on the machine you choose.

what-it-knows.text: A planner knows when you sleep, which doctor you see, and who you met on Tuesday.

someone-elses-product.text: And it runs on their computer. Atlassian defaults Jira and Confluence customers into using their content to train its AI.

most-people-quit.text: Moving means moving all of it at once, into another company's database. Most people quit right about here.

title-card.text: Companion Planning is the other way round. Your whole plan is one SQLite file you can copy and keep.

the-week.text: It places your work around the meetings you already have.

the-arithmetic.text: A week is a hundred and sixty-eight hours. Sleep takes sixty-three. You spend the rest on purpose.

the-dial.text: How much it does without asking is a dial you hold.
